The scene is set inside a large public aquarium, illuminated by the blue light reflecting from a massive glass tank filled with diverse marine life. 

There are four prominent people in the foreground looking up with expressions of wonder. On the far left, a woman with dark hair wears a dark top. Next to her, a man with short dark hair is wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a grey backpack; he is looking upward and to the right. Beside him, a woman with shoulder-length brown hair and a cream-colored top looks up attentively. In front of them, a young boy with dark hair and a light blue striped t-shirt stands close to the glass, gazing upward with wide eyes and his hands raised. In the mid-ground and background, other blurred visitors are visible, along with reflections of people on the curved glass surface.

The massive aquarium exhibit dominates the right side of the frame. Inside the water, several sea creatures are clearly visible, including a large white-silver fish swimming horizontally on the right, sharks in the upper section, and smaller tropical fish darting among yellow and green coral reefs that rest on the sandy bottom. The upper part of the water is a deep sapphire blue, gradually lightening towards the rocky, coral-covered bottom.

Spatial layout: Left: woman in dark top and man in blue shirt. Center: woman in cream top and young boy. Right: large aquarium tank with fish, sharks, and coral.

The scene is set in a brightly lit indoor aquarium exhibition room, centered around a wide, low, circular touch pool filled with clear water, sand, and marine life. 

There are several people gathered around the pool, leaning in to touch the water. On the far left foreground, a young blonde girl with a pink hair bow leans forward, looking down with a smile. Behind her stands a woman with dark hair in a dark t-shirt, smiling as she watches. Next to them, a young boy in a green shirt reaches into the water. Behind him stands a man wearing a grey t-shirt, a baseball cap backward, and sunglasses tucked into his collar, pointing down toward the pool while looking at the water. Beside the man, an older woman with short brown hair and a floral blouse looks on, while a small dark-haired girl in a white shirt stands in front of her, reaching into the pool. Further right, a young boy with glasses wearing a light blue button-down shirt reaches his hand out over the water. On the far right foreground, a young woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a blue polo shirt, leans over the edge of the pool with both hands on the sandy bottom, smiling toward the water. In the background, several other blurred figures stand near a dark blue wall.

Inside the touch pool, various sea creatures, including starfish and rays, rest on the light-colored sandy floor. The rim of the pool is made of rough, light-colored stone blocks. 

Spatial layout: Left: Two women and two children gathered by the pool edge. Center: A man, an older woman, a young girl, and another boy leaning over the center of the pool. Right: A woman in a blue shirt pointing into the far side of the pool, with blurred visitors in the background.

This image shows an art gallery interior featuring a couple viewing landscape paintings. The setting is a spacious, well-lit exhibition room with polished wooden floors, white walls, and a recessed ceiling with track lighting. Several framed landscape paintings in ornate gold frames hang along the walls at eye level. A simple wooden bench stands in the foreground on the right side of the room.

Two people stand side-by-side in the center of the foreground, facing away from the viewer toward a large painting on the left wall. To the left is a woman with long brown hair wearing a warm brown or tan knit sweater (not bright yellow), blue jeans, and white sneakers. Her arms are crossed loosely as she observes the artwork. To her right is a man with short dark hair wearing a dark jacket, blue jeans, and white sneakers. He stands close to the woman, also looking at the painting.

In the background, multiple other framed paintings are visible on distant walls, and an arched doorway leads to another gallery space containing more distant artwork. The lighting overhead creates soft shadows on the floor beneath the visitors and the bench.

Spatial layout: Left: A large landscape painting on the wall. Center: A man and woman standing together, viewed from behind, facing left. Foreground: A wooden bench. Right: A smaller framed painting and a larger landscape painting further down the wall.

This eye-level photograph captures an outdoor urban scene during the daytime, likely outside a bank or financial institution. 

The main subject is a single adult man standing in the foreground on the left side of the frame, facing toward the right in profile. He is using an automated teller machine (ATM). He has short dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark blue hooded winter jacket, blue jeans, and a dark blue ribbed beanie pulled down over his head. His expression is focused and neutral. With his right hand, he inserts or removes a white card from the illuminated green slot on the ATM interface. In his left hand, which is held lower near his waist, he holds a small piece of paper or receipt. 

The ATM is set into a gray stone and metal wall structure on the right side of the image. The machine features a dark gray housing, a lit display screen showing no active text, a numeric keypad below the screen, an illuminated card reader slot, and a receipt dispenser slot at the bottom from which a receipt emerges. Two small inset lights illuminate the top interior recess of the ATM station. In the background on the left, the dark metal and glass facade of a building with large doors and windows reflects blurry street surroundings. The pavement underfoot is composed of clean grey stone slabs.

Spatial layout: Left: Man in dark jacket facing right at the ATM. Center/Right: ATM built into a gray wall panel with integrated screen, keypad, and slots. Background: Glass and metal storefront reflection on the far left.

This sunny tropical beach scene shows a scenic coastline with crystal-clear turquoise water and a wide expanse of fine white sand. On the right, a line of tall palm trees casts shadows over multiple white beach loungers and open beige sun umbrellas. Several tourists relax on the loungers or lounge chairs, sunbathing or reading; most wear swimsuits in bright colors like pink and blue. Further back on the beach, a few people stroll along the shoreline. In the distance, large white resort hotels with domed architecture stand against a bright blue sky dotted with fluffy white cumulus clouds.

In the shallow water on the left, several people are wading, swimming, or floating. In the foreground of the water, a man with dark hair swims toward the left, while another person nearby faces right. Further out, other swimmers are visible, some facing towards the shore and others looking out to sea. In the immediate right foreground, a blue and white patterned beach towel lies on the sand alongside a pair of blue swim fins. 

Spatial layout: Left: shallow turquoise water with swimming and wading people. Center: shoreline with gentle waves meeting the white sand and distant resort buildings. Right: sandy beach lined with palm trees, sun umbrellas, lounge chairs, and relaxing tourists.

The scene is set in a spacious, warmly lit bookstore lined with rows of dark wooden bookshelves packed with books. In the center foreground, a young woman with fair skin, light blonde hair, and round tortoiseshell glasses stands facing slightly to her right. She wears a light gray crew-neck knit sweater and has a brown leather shoulder bag strap across her body. Her expression is focused and thoughtful as she compares two books. In her left hand, she holds a book with a dark cover and white pages, tilted slightly upward. In her right hand, she holds a second book with a light-colored or white cover, examining it closely while holding it near eye level. 

The background shows endless aisles of bookshelves receding into the distance, filled with tightly packed volumes of various colors. To the left, a wooden display table holds piles of books, and the blurred interior of another section of the store extends further back. To the right, tall shelves display colorful spines on upper tiers and neat rows of books below. The atmosphere is quiet, academic, and calm, typical of a cozy independent bookstore.

Spatial layout: Left: bookshelves and a display table with books. Center: a blonde woman in a gray sweater holding two books. Right: prominent tall wooden bookshelves stocked with numerous books.

The scene is set outdoors on a sidewalk terrace of a European-style street café during daytime. A male waiter stands in the middle-ground, wearing a black shirt, a black apron, and black trousers, holding a tray with two white cups and a glass, looking slightly downward. In the foreground, a couple sits at a small square wooden table. The man on the left wears a dark green hoodie and glasses, facing right and gesturing with his right hand toward the woman while speaking. The woman in the center wears a white long-sleeved button-down shirt and round sunglasses, smiling broadly while looking toward the man and resting her hand on her chin. On their table, there is a small cup of coffee, a small metal pitcher, a plate with a croissant, and a glass of water. To their right and further back, another man in a light blue button-down shirt is seated facing right, while additional patrons and blurred figures sit at other tables in the background under an awning. Beyond the terrace, a cobbled street is visible with parked bicycles and classic stone buildings with multiple windows under warm daylight.

Spatial layout: Left: Foreground couple at a table. Center: Male waiter holding a serving tray. Right: Background patrons seated at tables, a street with bicycles, and buildings.

Setting and location: An outdoor stone courtyard within a medieval castle or fortress, paved with cobblestones and enclosed by weathered stone walls and towers under a partly cloudy blue sky.

People: There are six adults visible in a group tour setting. 

Left foreground: A tall man in a grey t-shirt, light khaki shorts, sunglasses, and a black backpack. He wears a black camera on a strap around his neck and looks rightward with a neutral expression. 

Left-center foreground: A woman with dark sunglasses and shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white tank top and dark shorts. She has a black handbag on her shoulder and a camera on a strap, and she looks up and rightward. 

Center foreground: A man in a dark navy blue t-shirt and light beige shorts, wearing sunglasses and a camera around his neck. He stands with his hands in his pockets, looking rightward.

Center-right foreground: A woman with blonde hair, sunglasses, and a striped black-and-white tank top with beige shorts. She has a camera around her neck, wears light sandals, and looks forward with a gentle smile.

Background (center-right): A woman in a wide-brimmed sun hat, sunglasses, and a white top, standing slightly behind. Partially visible beside her is another person, mostly obscured.

Right foreground: A tour guide seen from behind and in profile, wearing a light-colored baseball cap, a beige button-down shirt, jeans, and a large black backpack. He gestures with his right hand as if explaining something to the group.

Key objects: Multiple digital cameras with neck straps worn by the tourists, sunglasses, backpacks, stone castle towers, cobblestone ground.

Spatial layout: Left: two tourists (man in grey, woman in white). Center: two tourists (man in navy, woman in stripes). Background: tour participants. Right: tour guide with backpack facing the group.

This photo captures a classical orchestra concert inside a grand, ornate concert hall with warm golden lighting, tiered red seating, and rows of audience members facing the stage. On the stage, an orchestra of around thirty musicians is arranged in rows. They are wearing dark formal attire, playing instruments such as violins, cellos, flutes, and a harp. In the center of the stage, the conductor stands with his back to the audience, arms raised slightly while holding a baton to direct the performance. The background features deep red walls separated by gold pilasters, and a balcony on the right filled with more seated audience members. A large crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling near the right side. In the foreground and middle ground, hundreds of audience members are seated, seen mostly from behind. They are dressed in various dark and neutral jackets and sweaters, with a few light-colored garments visible. A woman in the foreground left has white hair; several people have blonde or dark hair. They are all facing forward, watching the performance on stage. Spatial layout: Left: stage with musicians and harp; Center: conductor and the main body of the orchestra; Right: auditorium seating with audience and balcony level.

The scene is set inside a convenience store or small shop, featuring a counter with merchandise. There are two people visible. On the left in the foreground is a customer, a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue denim jacket, dark pants, and a black backpack. She is facing right toward the cashier, holding out a black credit card or smartphone to make a contactless payment. On the right behind the counter is a female store employee or cashier with dark hair tied back, wearing a dark blue collared polo shirt. She is smiling cheerfully at the customer while reaching out to accept the payment. 

On the counter between them sits a plastic-wrapped bag of snacks, a dark bottle of soda with a blue cap, and a clear plastic cup filled with a pink smoothie and a blue straw. To the right of the counter is a glass display case filled with rows of snacks and packaged items. In the background behind the cashier, wooden shelves are stocked with various bottles, packaged goods, and some fresh fruit including bananas and oranges. Behind the customer, large refrigerated display coolers with glass doors contain rows of beverages. The overall lighting is bright and indoor.

Spatial layout: Left: customer in denim jacket facing right. Center: counter with snacks, soda, and smoothie cup. Right: smiling cashier in blue polo shirt facing left, next to a glass display case.

Inside a brightly lit clothing store or boutique, a young woman with long, straight brown hair is shopping. She stands in the center of the frame, facing to the right toward a clothing rack. She wears a beige trench coat over a white top and has a black shoulder bag strap visible. In her left hand, she holds several paper shopping bags with handles, while her right hand is holding up a dark brown jacket on a hanger, inspecting the fabric of the sleeve. Her expression is calm, focused, and evaluative as she examines the garment.

The store interior features multiple clothing racks filled with garments. To the left, blurred racks display white coats and other items. To the right, neat rows of hangers hold white shirts, dark tops, and another brown jacket hanging closely in the foreground. The background shows the soft-focus, modern retail environment with warm ceiling lights creating a gentle bokeh effect across the upper portion of the scene.

Spatial layout: Left: Background clothing racks and shopping bag handles. Center: A young woman in a beige trench coat examining a garment. Right: Racks of shirts and a brown jacket on a hanger.

This indoor scene shows a flower shop or florist's stall. On the left in the foreground is a customer, a young woman with brown hair tied back in a ponytail, seen from the back and side as she faces right toward the counter. She wears a light blue t-shirt and a dark shoulder bag. On the right, behind the counter, is a female florist wearing a white tank top and a dark gray apron, smiling warmly as she faces left toward the customer. She is holding out a brightly colored bouquet of flowers wrapped in brown paper, containing pink, orange, and red blooms. The customer is reaching out with her right hand to receive the flowers. 

The background features numerous metal buckets filled with various flowers and greenery arranged on wooden shelves. Behind the customer are lush green spherical plants in a metallic bucket. Behind the florist and toward the center are white lilies in buckets, and to the far right are more pink and purple floral arrangements in tall silver containers. A wooden counter surface runs along the lower center of the frame. 

Spatial layout: Left: Customer in light blue t-shirt facing right. Center: Wooden counter and bouquet exchange. Right: Florist in apron smiling and handing over flowers, surrounded by shelves of flowers in buckets.

This image shows an outdoor petrol station setting beneath a white canopy roof. There is one man in the foreground, shown from the waist up, who appears to be a driver or customer. He stands on the left side of the frame, facing right toward a dark blue car. The man has short dark hair and a beard, and he wears a dark blue zip-up jacket over blue jeans. His expression is focused and neutral as he looks down at the fuel nozzle. 

He holds a black fuel pump nozzle inserted into the fuel tank opening on the side of the car. The dark blue SUV or hatchback is positioned on the right side of the image, angled slightly toward the viewer. Its red tail light and side window are clearly visible, reflecting the surrounding environment. A black hose connects the fuel nozzle in the man's hand to a pump unit on the left. In the background behind the car and the man, there are white fuel dispenser islands, concrete pavement under the canopy, a red fire extinguisher, and lush green trees beneath an overcast sky. 

Spatial layout: Left: Fuel pump infrastructure and a man in a dark jacket holding a fuel nozzle. Center: Open paved area under the canopy with distant background trees. Right: The rear and side of a dark blue car receiving fuel.

This brightly lit hair salon features a female hairdresser cutting a male client's hair. On the left side of the frame stands a female hairdresser with long brown and blonde wavy hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and a white watch. She faces right toward the client, her expression focused as she holds a black comb in her right hand and scissors in her left, trimming the client's hair. In the right foreground sits a male client with short brown hair and a short beard, facing right and away from the camera. He wears a black protective barber's cape draped over his shoulders and torso. The salon interior includes a large vertical mirror on the right reflecting the room, and shelves on the background walls holding bottles of hair products. Additional background elements include a dark chair in the lower left corner and a counter unit with more bottles on the right. 

Spatial layout: Left: female hairdresser facing right. Center-right: male client facing right. Background: salon shelves, mirror, and styling station.

This outdoor photo shows a group of six adult tourists standing on a paved cobblestone plaza, gathered in front of an ornate historical stone building. The tourists are positioned in a loose horizontal line across the foreground, all looking upward and to the left. 

On the far left, an older woman with blonde hair, sunglasses, and a blue denim jacket over a patterned top and white trousers points her left arm upward toward the left. Next to her, a man with a beard and sunglasses wears a light green button-down shirt and carries a camera with his hands, gazing upward. Beside him, a younger woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail wears a plaid flannel shirt and jeans, holding a small folded map and looking up. To her right, a woman with dark curly hair and sunglasses wears a white long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, also looking upward with a slight smile. Next to her, a young Asian man wearing glasses and a dark shirt looks up with his hand touching his neck. On the far right stands a man in a grey t-shirt, beige shorts, and sunglasses, carrying a dark backpack and looking up with his hands in his pockets. All six individuals face diagonally upward and slightly left.

The background features a large historic building with classical columns, arched niches, and statues. Further back on the right, multi-story urban buildings and a streetlamp are visible. 

Spatial layout: Left: blonde woman pointing and man with camera. Center: woman with map and woman in white shirt. Right: young man in glasses and man with backpack.

This is an indoor hotel lobby setting with a reception desk, a lounge area, and luggage carts. There are three people visible in the scene. On the far left, a male bellhop stands smiling in the background next to a large gold luggage cart loaded with two suitcases; he wears a white button-down shirt, a black vest and tie, dark trousers, and white gloves, and he is facing forward and slightly to the right. In the center, a couple is checking in at the marble reception desk. The man stands on the left side of the couple, facing right toward the receptionist; he wears a light blue blazer, dark trousers, white shoes, and holds the handle of a black rolling suitcase. The woman stands next to him, facing the receptionist on the right; she wears a black long-sleeved top, white trousers, tan heels, and carries a tan shoulder bag. Behind the marble counter on the right, a female receptionist with dark hair tied in a ponytail smiles and hands a card to the female guest; she wears a dark blazer over a white shirt. The foreground includes a round black coffee table with a small floral arrangement of white and green flowers, and portions of upholstered lounge seating. The background features dark wood paneling, a textured wall behind the reception desk, stairs, and tall green potted plants on the left and right.

Spatial layout: Left: bellhop and luggage cart in the background; Center: a couple with a rolling suitcase facing right at the reception desk; Right: a receptionist behind the desk.

This kitchen scene is captured during morning preparation. In the background stands a man with dark hair, a beard, and a gray t-shirt, positioned slightly left of center and facing right toward the stove. He is actively cooking eggs in a pan on the gas range, using a small utensil with a focused expression. 

The kitchen features white subway tile walls, dark cabinetry, and light countertops. Above the stove is a stainless steel range hood, and behind the pan sits a silver kettle. To the right of the stove, a metal holder contains several wooden kitchen utensils, alongside glass bottles and a small potted plant on the counter. In the immediate foreground on a wooden surface, a plate holds two slices of toasted bread, next to a bowl filled with colorful mixed fruit, a white mug, and a glass coffee carafe filled with dark coffee. Sunlight streams in through the window on the far left, illuminating the sink area and casting soft morning shadows across the counters.

Spatial layout: Left: sink and window area with the man cooking at the stove. Center: gas stove and range hood. Right: countertop items including utensils, plant, and coffee carafe with breakfast items in the immediate foreground.

The scene is set in a brightly lit laundromat with a clean tiled floor. In the foreground, a young woman with brown hair tied in a ponytail is kneeling and facing to the left in profile. She is loading or unloading laundry from a large, stainless steel front-loading washing machine. She wears a long light grey cardigan, blue jeans, and white sneakers. Her expression is focused as she handles a bundle of gray and white clothing. 

Immediately beside her, in the foreground on the floor, is a white plastic laundry basket filled with various garments, including blue jeans and gray fabrics. In the background behind the woman, more stainless steel commercial washing machines are arranged in a neat row against the wall. To the right, further back in the background, stands another group of stacked commercial washing machines with round glass doors and digital control panels. A white laundry hamper with a mesh pattern is positioned on the floor in the far right background, with a white cloth draped over its edge. The overall atmosphere is modern, orderly, and calm.

Spatial layout: Left: Commercial washing machines. Center: A kneeling woman loading laundry next to a white laundry basket. Right: Additional stacked washing machines and a second laundry basket in the background.

This scene takes place at a bustling outdoor farmers' market under white canopy tents. Numerous patrons and vendors populate the crowded stalls. 

In the immediate foreground, a female vendor with tied-up dark hair and a gray long-sleeved shirt over a dark apron smiles as she hands a large bunch of red-stemmed leafy greens to a female customer. The customer, with shoulder-length dark hair and a light-colored sweater, stands facing left, receiving the vegetables with a pleasant expression while holding a beige canvas tote bag filled with greens. 

Surrounding them is an abundant display of fresh produce: vibrant yellow squash and dark green zucchini on the lower left, mounds of earthy root vegetables like carrots, and piles of small red radishes, white turnips, and red onions. Behind the vendor, other shoppers and stall workers are visible in various positions, dressed in casual jackets and shirts, browsing the market. To the far right, a man in a dark baseball cap, blue long-sleeved shirt, and tan shorts stands facing toward the center, observing the scene. Additional stacks of colorful tomatoes in plastic containers sit on the tables near the center.

Spatial layout: Left: Vendor handing greens and extensive displays of squash, carrots, and radishes. Center: Customer receiving produce and fruit display boxes. Right: Additional shoppers, including a man in a blue shirt. Background: Crowded market under white tents.

This image shows a dimly lit cinema during a movie screening, filled with an audience. The scene focuses on a group of young adults sitting closely together in rows of plush theater seats, all facing toward the front screen, which casts a warm glow on their faces.

In the left foreground, a smiling man with short dark hair wears a plain white crew-neck t-shirt. Seated right next to him is a smiling blonde woman with her hair worn down, wearing a dark green utility-style jacket. She holds a black container of popcorn and is in the process of eating. 

Further back to the right, another woman with dark hair wears a beige long-sleeve top. She is smiling and holding a red cup with a straw while looking toward the screen. Beside her, a man with short blonde hair and a dark shirt watches the film attentively. Additional audience members are visible blurred in the rows behind them, creating a sense of a full theater. The overall mood is cheerful, relaxed, and focused on the entertainment.

Spatial layout: Left: A man in a white t-shirt. Center: A blonde woman eating popcorn. Right: A dark-haired woman holding a red drink and a blonde man next to her. Background: Rows of blurred theater seats and other audience members.

The image shows a retail store setting, likely a clothing boutique, featuring two adult women interacting at a checkout counter. In the left foreground, a woman with shoulder-length blonde hair is facing right toward the counter. She wears a long-sleeved purple sweater and has a brown shoulder strap visible on her arm. Her facial expression is tense and upset, with knitted brows, an open mouth showing teeth, and her left hand raised in a questioning gesture with an open palm. In the right foreground, a woman with dark hair styled in a high bun is shown from the back and side, facing left toward the blonde woman. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved top and appears to be working as a cashier behind the counter. A black card payment terminal with colorful buttons sits on the counter between them, alongside a computer monitor displaying a light-colored screen. Stacked items wrapped in pink-and-white striped fabric rest on a lower counter to the far left. The background reveals a retail environment with hanging garments on racks, shelves holding purses including a prominent tan tote bag on the upper left, and a striped black-and-white garment hanging in the mid-background. Spatial layout: Left: Blonde woman in a purple sweater facing right. Center: Payment terminal and computer monitor on the counter. Right: Woman with a bun in a black top facing left. Visible clues for speculation tasks include the blonde woman's aggressive facial expression, raised hand gesture, and mouth position, which serve as visible evidence of a customer complaint or dispute regarding a transaction.

This outdoor daytime photograph captures the exterior of a suburban house, focusing on a shattered window. The setting features a neatly manicured green lawn in the foreground, bordered by a low foundation wall built of red and brown bricks. Directly in front of this brick base, resting on the grass, is a white leather baseball with prominent red stitching. There are no people visible in the scene. 

To the right of the brick and grass area, a large white-framed window is set into beige horizontal siding. The glass pane of this window is heavily cracked, featuring a central impact point with numerous radial fractures stretching outward across the glass. The reflection in the intact window pane to the right shows dark mesh, likely a screen, and the silhouette of outdoor foliage. In the background to the left, a portion of the house extends backward, showing a darker shingled roof, a porch area supported by white pillars, and another window on a side wall. A large, rounded green bush stands prominently on the far left side of the frame, partially obscuring the corner of the house.

Spatial layout: Left: A rounded green bush and part of the house exterior. Center: A low brick foundation wall with a baseball resting on the grass in front of it. Right: A large white-framed window with a heavily cracked glass pane.

Visible clues for speculation tasks include the baseball resting on the grass directly beneath the window, combined with the distinct spiderweb pattern of cracks and central impact mark on the glass.

This natural outdoor scene shows a paved two-lane road winding through a rural or mountainous region under an overcast sky. In the background, rolling green hills and distant mountain peaks are visible, alongside scattered trees and bushes lining the roadside.

A single person is present: a young woman with long brown hair tied in a ponytail, wearing sunglasses perched on her head. She stands on the gravel shoulder beside the road, facing left toward a disabled grey sedan. She wears a blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt, matching blue denim jeans, and exhibits a concerned expression with her hand touching her head and her other hand resting on her hip, conveying frustration and distress over the vehicle trouble.

The grey sedan is parked on the shoulder with its hood propped open. Thick white steam or smoke billows visibly from the engine compartment, providing a direct visual clue for learners to speculate about an overheating engine, mechanical failure, or radiator leak. Inside the car through the front window, miscellaneous items or bags are visible piled on the passenger seat.

Spatial layout: Left: smoking engine and front of the grey sedan. Center: hood prop and driver-side mirror. Right: frustrated woman standing on the roadside shoulder, facing the car, with the empty road and mountains stretching into the background.

Visible evidence for speculation tasks: The billowing steam from the engine bay points to potential overheating, cooling system failure, or a blown gasket, while the woman's stressed body language suggests she is stranded and waiting for assistance or trying to figure out what to do next.

The scene takes place outdoors in a public park, featuring a young man and a young woman sitting side by side on a dark wooden park bench. Their body language suggests tension or a disagreement: both individuals have their arms crossed tightly over their chests and are looking away from each other in opposite directions. 

On the left side of the bench sits a woman with long, dark straight hair. She wears a beige trench coat over a black turtleneck sweater and dark trousers. Her head is turned slightly to the left, and her facial expression is serious and pensive. On the right side of the bench sits a man with short dark hair, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a grey sweater under an olive-green bomber jacket and light-colored trousers. His head is turned toward the right, his jaw is slightly clenched, and his gaze is directed away from his companion. Neither person is looking at or speaking to the other.

In the background, there is a large dark tree trunk immediately behind the bench, flanked by lush green foliage and grassy areas. Further back on the left, a multi-story building with tall windows is partially visible, suggesting an urban park setting. 

Spatial layout: Left: woman in a beige trench coat sitting on the left side of the bench facing left. Center: large tree trunk and wooden park bench. Right: man in an olive-green jacket sitting on the right side of the bench facing right.

For speculation tasks: Visible clues that could support guesses about their situation include their closed-off posture (arms crossed) and averted gazes, which visually indicate conflict, annoyance, or a recent argument.

This interior image shows a modern corporate office at night or late evening. The scene is devoid of people; there are zero human figures visible anywhere in the room.

The primary foreground features an organized wooden desk with a black mesh office chair positioned in front of it. On the desk, there is a computer monitor displaying a bright white screen, accompanied by a black keyboard and mouse. Visible items on the desk include a stack of papers, a small potted green plant, a disposable coffee cup, a glass tumbler, and some pens. Further back, similar workstation setups are visible with computer monitors and desk lamps casting warm, localized pools of light against the surrounding gloom. Large windows behind the desks reveal the illuminated grid of a distant city skyline in the dark night.

Spatial layout: Left: A foreground desk cluttered with papers, a plant, and a monitor. Center: A black ergonomic mesh office chair facing the desk and monitor. Right: Additional background workstations with computers and glowing desk lamps near the windows.

Visible clues for speculation tasks include the brightly lit monitor screens left on, empty seats, stacks of paperwork, and the darkened city windows. These elements provide visible evidence that could support reasonable guesses about someone having recently stepped away, working late overtime, or finishing up a shift before leaving the office empty for the night.

In a clothing store interior, two young women stand near racks of garments. The woman on the left has long, curly dark brown hair and wears a mustard-yellow sweater under a tan jacket. She holds a light-brown hooded coat on a hanger in her left hand and a blue denim jacket on a hanger in her right hand. Her facial expression is doubtful and displeased, with furrowed eyebrows and a pursed mouth as she examines the denim jacket. The woman on the right has long, straight light-brown hair and wears a white textured long-sleeved sweater. She faces slightly left toward the other woman, pointing with her right index finger toward the denim jacket with a gentle, encouraging smile. A black purse strap is visible over her right shoulder. 

The background features rows of clothing hanging on racks in a well-lit retail environment. Shelves stacked with folded garments and a tan handbag are visible on upper shelves in the upper left background, while the blurred interior extends into the distance on the right. 

Spatial layout: Left: woman with curly hair holding two jackets; Center: denim jacket being evaluated; Right: woman in white sweater gesturing and smiling.
